author: Susanna Clarke
synopsis:
Piranesi dwells inside the House, a place he may have inhabited his entire life. Through his daily journals, he meticulously chronicles its incredible features: an endless maze of corridors, countless unique statues, roaring tides that flood the staircases, and weather patterns drifting through the higher rooms. Twice a week, on Tuesdays and Fridays, he meets with his companion, the Other. Occasionally, he leaves offerings for the skeletons he finds. Yet, for the most part, solitude defines his existence.

Soon, chalk-written messages start showing up on the floors, indicating the presence of a newcomer within the endless halls. As Piranesi tries to figure out the identity and motives of this mysterious entity, the Other warns that the newcomer is a source of chaos and ruin. 

As forgotten writings are uncovered and hidden truths emerge, the reality Piranesi has always relied upon transforms into a perilous and unfamiliar domain.
title: Piranesi
